import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax1.text(width + breed_counts.values.max()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'{int(width):,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by age group
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique(),
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + age_counts.values.max()*0.01,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', fontsize=9, rotation=0)

# 3. Dog gender distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index,
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)

# 4. Dog registrations by district
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels([f'Kreis {i}' for i in range(1, 13)], fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + district_counts.values.max()*0.01,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. Dog color distribution (top 10)
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax5.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax5.invert_yaxis()
ax5.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Top 10 Dog Colors', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax5.text(width + color_counts.values.max()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'{int(width):,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 6. Dog registrations over years
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for x, y in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):
    ax6.text(x, y + year_counts.values.max()*0.02, f'{int(y):,}',
             ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Owner age distribution
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax7.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + owner_age_counts.values.max()*0.01,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 8. Owner gender distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
owner_gender_counts = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#95E1D3']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(owner_gender_counts.values, labels=owner_gender_counts.index,
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax8.set_title('Dog Owner Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)

# 9. Breed type distribution
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
breed_type_counts = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
bars = ax9.bar(range(len(breed_type_counts)), breed_type_counts.values)
ax9.set_xticks(range(len(breed_type_counts)))
ax9.set_xticklabels(breed_type_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax9.set_xlabel('Breed Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_title('Dog Breed Type Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax9.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + breed_type_counts.values.max()*0.01,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor
